purpose: Case-level anomaly flagging for FAERS reports (signal-management triage)
caveats: Unsupervised: there is no ground-truth label for 'this report deserves review', so 'anomaly' means 'statistically unusual given this drug's typical report profile', not 'confirmed safety issue'.
contamination=0.05 is an analyst-chosen assumption (expect ~5% of reports to be flagged), not derived from data.
33.3% of reports were missing patient age and had it imputed with the cohort median — flagged reports with imputed age should be interpreted with that in mind.
